title: Proof of Work
subtitle: Her first single
cover_alt: Cover art for Proof of Work: Linkke, an anime-style AI idol with long pink pigtails and turquoise eyes, sings into a pink microphone and reaches one gloved hand toward the viewer on a neon concert stage with a glowing pink heart on her navy jacket. The cover reads LINKKE at the top, PROOF OF WORK in large glitchy letters, and PRACTICALITY CO. at the bottom.
